look_kind: CONFIRMATORY (single pre-registered look on the forward cohort; family bar one-sided 0.025; three-way verdict language; no second look)
stage_1: docs/research/insider_cluster_retro_design_2026_09_03.md (ledger id insider_cluster_retro_2026_09; +0.76 pp, 90% CI [+0.21, +1.31]) - a DESIGN INPUT, not evidence in this test
detection_module: apps/alphalens-pipeline/alphalens_pipeline/events/insider_cluster.py (PR #1295; constants below are pinned to this module by a parity test)

population.unit: ticker-episode (one event per ticker per 20 sessions, first wins; dedup runs on ALL detected clusters BEFORE the exclusions)
population.rows_counted: eligible == True AND (source == insider_cluster OR event_overlap == True), brief_date >= accrual_start
population.shadow_arm: eligible == False rows (exclusion_reason set), same arrival and outcome construction, descriptive only, can never affect the verdict
population.overlap_rule: one card per ticker per day; thematic catalyst primary; the primary analysis is ALL eligible episodes; the two cohort labels overlap by design and are not additive; overlap share reported at episode and ticker level

event.leg: transaction_code P, acquired_disposed A, is_amendment False, is_officer or is_director AS FLAGGED ON THE FILING, price present, shares*price >= LEG_MIN_USD
event.cluster: >= CLUSTER_MIN_INSIDERS distinct reporting_owner_cik with qualifying legs filed within CLUSTER_WINDOW_SESSIONS trading sessions INCLUSIVE of the first leg's filed_date (completing filed_date <= advance_trading_sessions(first filed_date, CLUSTER_WINDOW_SESSIONS)); cluster USD >= CLUSTER_MIN_USD (CLUSTER_MIN_USD_CHECK reported as a strength check)
event.event_date: filed_date of the leg that completes the insider count; same-day ties ordered by accession_number; later amendments never retract or move an event
event.dedup: DEDUP_SESSIONS per ticker, first wins (supersedes the parent memo's 5-session line)

arrival_and_brief_date.acceptance: EDGAR <ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME> of the completing filing via the canonical SEC client; unknown -> treated as after-hours
arrival_and_brief_date.arrival: acceptance before PRE_OPEN_CUTOFF_ET on filing date F -> session F; otherwise next session
arrival_and_brief_date.brief_date: D = F if accepted before PRE_OPEN_CUTOFF_ET else F + 1 calendar day; invariant session_on_or_after(D) == arrival
arrival_and_brief_date.anchor_event: arrival-session OPEN (first PUBLIC-INFORMATION price; the filing and the 22:30 ET store refresh precede it; stage-1 estimand and ladder anchor)
arrival_and_brief_date.anchor_reader: OPEN of session_on_or_after(D + 1 calendar day) - the first session after the brief carrying the row exists (its 04:30 UTC refresh precedes that open)
arrival_and_brief_date.store_lag_failure: brief D is (re)built only during calendar day D+1; an SEC daily-index lag > 1 day drops the event (never surfaced); counted and reported, not an exclusion

exclusions_in_order: late_filing: completing leg filed > LATE_FILING_BDAYS business days after its transaction_date
mcap_unknown: no market cap obtainable at detection
mcap_out_of_bracket: market cap outside EVENT_MCAP_RANGE at detection
sic_excluded: SIC in EXCLUDED_SIC (unknown SIC not excluded; ADRs structurally absent from Form 4)
earnings_window: next confirmed earnings date <= arrival + (EARNINGS_EXCLUSION_SESSIONS - 1) sessions (unknown not excluded; value stamped)
exclusion_inputs: market cap, SIC, next earnings date and acceptance time are stamped AS OBSERVED AT DETECTION and never recomputed or revised

outcomes.primary: car_20_event = (close[arrival + HORIZON_SESSIONS_PRIMARY] / open[arrival] - 1) - same for SPY; UNADJUSTED daily open/close from the population monitor grouped-daily cache (Polygon adjusted=false, SPY from the same rows); dividends ignored; split guard [SPLIT_RATIO_LO, SPLIT_RATIO_HI] on consecutive closes -> null
secondary: car_20_reader (anchor_reader open -> +HORIZON_SESSIONS_PRIMARY close, minus SPY, same guard)
net variants car_20_event - FEE_ROUND_TRIP and car_20_reader - FEE_ROUND_TRIP (one round trip per episode, fixed ticket, a transformation not a simulation)
outcomes.denominator: complete-case: eligible episodes with a non-null outcome for that horizon; null share and reasons reported; null share > 10% flagged in the verdict text; no delisting-return source exists

hypotheses.H1_primary: mean car_20_event of all eligible episodes > 0 (the ONLY confirmatory test)
hypotheses.H1b_secondary_dose_response: mean car_20_event(n_insiders >= 3) > mean car_20_event(n_insiders == 2); descriptive; never replaces H1

floor_and_looks.first_look_condition: N >= 150 eligible episodes with matured car_20_event (arrival + 19 sessions closed) AND >= 50 distinct arrival sessions among them
floor_and_looks.second_look: none; any later test of this lane is a new registration with its own programme charge
floor_and_looks.interim_peeks: forbidden (no dashboard, no partial mean or median); the /edge source chip shows the row count only
floor_and_looks.battery_script: committed under apps/alphalens-research/scripts/ml/ at least 30 sessions before the look, as an additive registration amendment

inference.clusters: arrival sessions (primary); ticker clusters and two-way ticker x arrival session as sensitivity

bootstrap.method: resample arrival-session clusters with replacement; recompute the episode-weighted mean each draw
bootstrap.one_sided_p: (1 + count(mean_b - mean_obs >= mean_obs)) / (n_boot + 1), i.e. the bootstrap distribution re-centred at zero

inference.family: 2 event classes in the lane (insider cluster; Schedule 13D reserved) x 1 primary test

verdict_rules_in_order.cleared: one_sided_p < 0.025 for mean(car_20_event) > 0 AND mean(car_20_event) - FEE_ROUND_TRIP > 0 AND mean(car_20_reader) - FEE_ROUND_TRIP > 0 -> lane stays ON; SIM-basket decision (#1299) opened; selection/ordering promotion needs its own registration
verdict_rules_in_order.evidence_against: 95% percentile-CI upper bound of mean(car_20_event) < smallest_actionable_effect -> flag OFF, lane retired, cohort frozen, postmortem row
verdict_rules_in_order.inconclusive: otherwise -> lane stays ON as display-only telemetry with no further test; operational retirement is an owner decision recorded in the ledger

verification_battery_if_cleared: exact reproduce from the frozen parquets
event_car_version and event_gate_version single-valued in the sample
descriptive_outputs: overlap share (episode and ticker level) and overlap-subset mean
ladder fill rate and realized_r of filled episodes
retail simulation with 3- and 5-name caps, equal-dollar, fee model, first-come
data-source failure rates (mcap_unknown, unknown acceptance, unknown earnings, store-lag drops)
abort_clause: abort uncharged only for outcome-blind defects found before the floor (detection bug, join integrity, store gaps); such a defect bumps event_gate_version and restarts the cohort; the moment any car_20_event aggregate is computed the look is spent
review_trail: adversarial review 2026-09-04 (zen deepseek-v4-pro high, 4 findings + Perplexity reason, 25 findings); adjudication in the design memo section 12
